breaking_changes: The /models API response no longer includes image_defaults or audio_defaults keys; values that were under those keys are now under recipe_options, so external clients reading the old fields will find them absent.

The /models response now includes a user_configurable boolean flag on backend descriptor options; consumers that assumed all listed options are editable may show technical knobs like soft_pixel_cap, pcm_sample_rate, and pcm_channels to users.
FLM v1.0.11 (bumped from v1.0.7) returns max_tokens exactly as requested rather than max_tokens+1, so chat completions that relied on the extra token will now stop one token early.
FLM v1.0.11 streams token usage counts only when stream_options.include_usage is set; without it the server's /api/v1/stats endpoint records no token counts or throughput for FLM streams.

FLM v1.0.11 returns 400 for previously-accepted invalid fields including invalid tool_choice, forced tool calls on small Qwen3 models (up to 1.7B), conversation history on *-flash models, and requests with no messages or prompt.

evidence.blockers: Three P0 items need clearing before release: (1) the /models response must verify that image_defaults and audio_defaults are fully migrated to recipe_options and that no external API clients break; (2) disabling save chat history must not erase previously saved conversations; (3) model downloads for ACE-Step, ThinkSound, and Moonshine variants must complete without missing files after the explicit-file-listing refactoring. Strix Halo hardware needed for ds4, gufo, halogen, rocmfpx backends; NVIDIA Linux x86_64 for TheNoise CUDA; SELinux-enforcing Fedora for ds4 edge case.
evidence.breaking_changes: The /models response shape changed: image_defaults and audio_defaults removed, values folded into recipe_options, and user_configurable flag added. External clients reading the old keys will break until updated. FLM v1.0.7→1.0.11 pin changes max_tokens exactness, makes streamed usage opt-in via stream_options.include_usage, and enforces stricter request validation returning 400 for previously-accepted invalid fields. Both require FLM clients to update.
evidence.coverage: Reviewed all 26 commits across the release range from v2026.45.3 to c2d3dbe. Coverage includes all backend additions (thenoise cuda, container backends for ds4, rocmfpx, halogen, gufo, llamacpp:nathanw, llamacpp:halobox), API changes (zero-shot classification, systemone decision models, /models response refactor, /v1/images/upscale parameter), GUI fixes (model handoff, chat history save toggle, load banners, Firefox sidebar prompt), model download refactoring (ACE-Step, ThinkSound, Moonshine explicit file listings), FLM pin bump to v1.0.11, and CI-only changes (validate_containers workflow, self-hosted runner matrix, benchmark rocm_version field).
evidence.manual_testing: NPU hardware required for FLM d3 decision model verification (c2d3dbe). Strix Halo (Fedora) hardware needed for ds4:rocm, gufo:rocm, halogen, rocmfpx backends. NVIDIA Linux x86_64 for TheNoise CUDA backend. SELinux-enforcing Fedora host for ds4 installation edge case. Docker-only host (no Podman) for ds4 compatibility. Ubuntu PPA and Fedora for llamacpp:nathanw container backend install/load/uninstall. Multiple platforms tested: Fedora, Ubuntu PPA, Windows, Snap, Docker, macOS, Debian.
evidence.security: Container backends use pinned image digests, allowlisted registries, and --cap-drop=all with no-new-privileges. The ort-server dependency bump (0.3.7→0.4.0) replaces tokenizers-cpp with Rust FFI over Hugging Face tokenizers, validated with 20,001 identical test cases. Control-character label validation added for systemone classifiers. The /no_think prefix scoping fix and SELinux fail-closed check are defensive hardening. No new credential handling or supply-chain risks beyond standard community container images.
